| $$                                                    
    Y_{c,i,t} \sim Binomial(p_{c,i,t},N_{c,i,t})        
    $$                                                  | Eqn 1 |

|  |  |
|----|---:|
| $$
logit(p_{c,i,t}) = \gamma_0 + \sum_{j=1}^{4}\gamma_j\cdot X_{j_{c,i,t}}
$$ | Eqn 2 |

|                                                          |       |
|----------------------------------------------------------|------:|
| $$                                                       
    N_{c,i,t} \sim Poisson(\lambda_{i,t}\times A_c)        
    $$                                                     | Eqn 3 |

|  |  |
|----|---:|
| $$
log(\lambda_{i,t}) = \alpha_0 + \sum_{j=1}^2 \alpha_j \cdot X_{j_{i,t}} + \sum_{k=1}^3 \alpha_k \cdot Z_{k_{i,t}} + \sum_{m=1}^4\sum_{n=m+1}^4 \alpha_{mn} \cdot Z_{m_{i,t}} \cdot X/Z_{n_{i,t}}
$$ | Eqn 4 |

|  |  |
|----|---:|
| $$                                                                  
   Z_{k_{i,t}} =  \sum_{l=1}^{NLags} X_{k_{i,t,l}} \cdot w_{k,l}      
   $$ | Eqn 5 |
